detail: The only value the model can carry is the 07:30 fasting glucose, which follows a dinner on the evening before the intervention night that is printed only as one third of an unstated daily energy requirement, with no grams and no clock time, so neither the meal nor the hours fasted can be written (the fed-state rule: glucose goes out, not in); the commission errors, hunger ratings and response times have no model marker.
